header.title: Quest 1: Battle for the Hill
header.author: RobOS Tabletop Studio
header.description: Enter the Capitol halls in Midterm Elections: Battle for the Hill. Storm the Briefing Room, Committee Chamber, War Room, and Oval Office—defeat the partisan bosses and the three Hydra Bosses (Talarixon, El-Rogers, and Brownsted), expose the bipartisan slush fund, and reach the Capitol exit stairs!

obama.name: Barack Obama
obama.weapon: Broadsword of Hope & Change (3 Combat Dice)

turnStart.text: Uhh... let me be clear... When you roll the dice... in this dungeon... you are not merely rolling plastic... you are rolling... the audacity... of hope.
Uhh... folks... Michelle and I... were talking just the other day... about how even in a dark corridor... filled with goblins... hope... always finds a way.
Uhh... make no mistake... The arc of the moral dungeon... is long... but it bends... toward hope... and... uhh... a modest middle-class tax cut.
Uhh... look... we can disagree... without being disagreeable... even when a two-headed hydra... is trying... to bite your head off... with hope.
Uhh... let me say this... Change does not roll in... on the wheels of inevitability... It rolls in... on two red six-sided dice... of hope.
Uhh... there is not a liberal dungeon... and a conservative dungeon... There is the United Dungeon... of America... and... uhh... we are lost in it.
Uhh... yes we can... step onto this next stone square... with the fierce urgency... of now... and the quiet dignity... of hope.
Uhh... if you like your broadsword... you can keep... your broadsword... Period... Full stop... Because that... is the promise... of hope.

turnStart.text: We live in a world today where there are several hundred million people starving to death — they're starving to death right now!
In some of the largest cities in America, 50% of the kids are not graduating high school! The cost of college education is zooming up, so you have to be a wealthy person to send your kid to college!

lines.text: You interrupted our Texas election hearing! If we refine the entire population of San Antonio into sweet Texas crude, diesel drops to 99 cents a gallon!

lines.text: Brethren, let us pray over the Alamo oil pipeline before we smite these four heroes and split the petroleum lobbyist check fifty-fifty!

storyTriggers.name: Mentor George W. Bush & Visions in the Mist
storyTriggers.title: Mentor George W. Bush & Visions in the Mist
storyTriggers.narrative: Mentor George W. Bush summons you to the Basement of Strategery to stop the Elite 1% by slaying the three Campaign Hydras (Talarixon, El-Rogers, and Brownsted)—though he has no idea how or if it will work! Meanwhile, from the foggy mist, girlfriends Marjorie Taylor Greene and AOC share canned-goods prepper advice for the oncoming AI Superintelligence Apocalypse!

actions.title: 🎬 Prologue: Mentor George W. Bush & The Mist Oracles

lines.speaker: mentor
lines.text: Howdy again, heroes! Remember your mission: stop the Elite 1% from destroyin' the world by slayin' all three Campaign Hydras: Talarixon, El-Rogers, and Brownsted! Now how is that gonna stop the 1%? Heck if I know! Good luck, I'm goin' back to paintin' my dog!

lines.speaker: obama
lines.text: Uhh... let me be clear... When we stand... at the bottom... of these Capitol stairs... we do not merely see... a dungeon... We see... the audacity... of hope... We see... a future... where hope... hopes... for more hope... and... uhh... maybe... a sandwich.

lines.speaker: bernie-sanders
lines.text: Let's talk about welfare for the rich and the powerful! Now, we start off from a proposition that the wealthiest 1% of the population in this country owns more wealth than the bottom 90%!

lines.speaker: hillary-clinton
lines.text: We've traveled to every corner of the United States. I've now been in 57 states. I think one left to go.

lines.speaker: trump
lines.text: They're eating the dogs. Sleepy Crooked Joe Biden. I really don't know what he said.

storyTriggers.name: Oval Office — Talarixon & The San Antonio Diesel Plot
storyTriggers.title: Oval Office — Talarixon & The San Antonio Diesel Plot
storyTriggers.narrative: Inside the Oval Office, the two heads of Talarixon (Talarico + Paxton · Texas Hydra) are debating converting the entire city of San Antonio into crude oil to lower Texas diesel prices before Donald Trump barges in!

actions.title: 🎬 Oval Office: The San Antonio Diesel Plot & Donald Trump

lines.speaker: Ken Paxton (Talarixon)
lines.text: You interrupted our Texas election hearing! If we refine the entire population of San Antonio into sweet Texas crude, diesel drops to 99 cents a gallon!

lines.speaker: James Talarico (Talarixon)
lines.text: Brethren, let us pray over the Alamo oil pipeline before we smite these four heroes and split the petroleum lobbyist check fifty-fifty!

lines.speaker: bernie-sanders
lines.text: President Reagan believed that if you provide massive tax breaks to the richest people in this country, somehow that wealth will trickle down to the rest of the population!

lines.speaker: trump
lines.text: They weaponized the government! They just gave me a 355 million dollar fine in New York — no victims, no defaults, the banks made money and testified for me!

lines.speaker: obama
lines.text: Uhh... folks... let us not... liquefy the good people... of San Antonio... into diesel fuel... Because hope... is not crude oil... Hope... is the thing... inside the thing... that makes us... uhh... hope.

lines.speaker: hillary-clinton
lines.text: We came, we saw, he died! Ha ha ha!

lines.speaker: mentor

storyTriggers.title: Senate Cloakroom — El-Rogers (Michigan Hydra) & Mist Oracles
storyTriggers.narrative: In the Senate Cloakroom lurks the second Campaign Hydra—El-Rogers (El-Sayed + Rogers · Michigan Hydra)—while Marjorie Taylor Greene and AOC appear in the mist with canned-goods tips!

lines.text: Halt, heroes! Before you can swing a broadsword in this cloakroom, you must fill out our Medicare-For-All-Monsters single-payer deductible form!

lines.speaker: Mike Rogers (El-Rogers)
lines.text: Too late, Abdul! My head already wiretapped your dungeon dice for the Elite 1% and uploaded your browser history to the AI Superintelligence!

lines.speaker: Marjorie Taylor Greene (From the Mist)
lines.text: Hey y'all, Marjorie here checking in from our cozy mist blanket! When the AI Superintelligence Apocalypse shuts down the power grid next Tuesday, remember rule #1: stockpile pull-tab canned Georgia peaches and at least four manual forged-iron can openers!

lines.speaker: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez (From the Mist)
lines.text: Tell 'em, babe! Because love is bipartisan, and high-fiber organic black beans and garbanzo beans in BPA-free tin cans will keep us thriving in the bunker until 2045!

lines.speaker: bernie-sanders
lines.text: This democracy is evolving into an oligarchy! And an oligarchy is a country in which a few people have tremendous wealth and tremendous power and exercise that wealth and that power!

lines.speaker: hillary-clinton
lines.text: What, like with a cloth or something? Well, no, I don't know how it works digitally at all! Bernie Sanders said that: 'The American people are sick and tired of hearing about your damn emails!'

lines.speaker: trump
lines.text: To do that, you have to be quite smart and you have to be able to hit the ball a long way. And I do it. He doesn't do it. He can't hit a ball 50 yards. He challenged me to a golf match. He can't hit a ball 50 yards!

lines.speaker: obama
lines.text: Uhh... let me be clear... That is two Hydras... consigned... to the dustbin... of history... When we believe... in the hope... of tomorrow's hope... we can... uhh... open these canned beans... together.

lines.speaker: mentor
lines.text: Well tickle my poncho, that's two Hydras belly-up! Only one Hydra left between you and... well, whatever it is we're doin' here!

storyTriggers.title: Supreme Court Chamber — Brownsted (Ohio Hydra) & Bunker Rotation

lines.text: Babe, tell the heroes about shelf rotation! When we're cuddling in our subterranean bunker hiding from ChatGPT-9000's killer drones, always rotate your canned garbanzo beans and lentils using First-In, First-Out!

lines.speaker: Marjorie Taylor Greene (From the Mist)
lines.text: That's right, honey! And always store your canned SPAM and beef stew up on wooden pallets off the damp dungeon floor so the tin never rusts!

lines.speaker: bernie-sanders
lines.text: We have an approach to campaign financing which, to a very large degree, allows wealthy people and major corporations to buy and sell politicians. The rich get richer, the poor get poorer, and ordinary Americans are shut out of the political system!

lines.speaker: hillary-clinton
lines.text: You made three speeches for Goldman Sachs... Did you have to be paid $675,000? Well, I don't know, that's what they offered!

quests.title: Quest 1: Battle for the Hill
quests.briefing: Enter the Capitol halls in Midterm Elections: Battle for the Hill. Storm the Briefing Room, Committee Chamber, War Room, and Oval Office—defeat the partisan bosses and the three Hydra Bosses (Talarixon, El-Rogers, and Brownsted), expose the bipartisan slush fund, and reach the Capitol exit stairs!
primaryGoals: Slay Talarixon (Texas Hydra) in the Oval Office.
Slay El-Rogers (Michigan Hydra) in the Senate Cloakroom.
Slay Brownsted (Ohio Hydra) in the Supreme Court Chamber.
